description:
Before becoming the star quarterback for the East Dillon Lions, Vince Howard (Michael B. Jordan) was a troubled kid on the verge of disaster. Watch his transformation from Coach Eric Taylor (Kyle Chandler) giving him a second chance through community service and inviting him to practice, to naming him quarterback and standing by his side when the police search the locker room.

Stream Friday Night Lights on Paramount+.
